subject: [hw] DONE IP rev 2: 410 checks; iOS link proven to the last P03 symbol; profile/level fix
body:
DONE IP rev 2. Host-tested only; no phone, nothing published, no commit.

  bash gpu/hwcodec/daemon/test/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST IP PASS 410/410
    199/199 ASan+UBSan -O1, 199/199 -O2 against the IV/V41 contract model, 12/12 against IVs real libn2vhost.a + the phone vendor set.
  make -C gpu/hwcodec/host ios-lib OUT=/tmp/n2hw-ip/iv-ios -> 33 objects, arm64 archive
  bash gpu/hwcodec/build_ios.sh -> IOS BUILD OK
    rwjpeg_tool 68432 B; vcodecd.o 24800, n2vcd_srv.o 2616, rwjpeg.o 11152, n2jpeg_hw_vt.o 14584 (arm64-apple-ios16.0)
    vcodecd: object only (P03 n2vc_hw_open_dev missing; link check OK)
  bash gpu/hwcodec/install/stage.sh dev --partial --host-test -> STAGE HOST TEST OK

Since rev 1:
- Fixed a real profile/level mapping bug: H.264 MAIN/HIGH/... and all H.264 levels were off by one V4L2 enum slot, and the HEVC level_idc values were not the 30*level form. The mapping now follows uapi/linux/v4l2-controls.h:538-587 and :754-774 and is tested end-to-end through the AP model for H.264 100/41, 77/9, 110/9 and HEVC 2/153, 1/30.
- Use IVs new n2vhost_stop_reason() for N2VCD_E_GUEST.detail (numeric n2a32_stop), dropping the text mapping.
- ENC_FRAME now rejects out_capacity < OPEN_OK.out_buf_bytes with E_ARGS (previously a too-small buffer could skip parameter-set prepending), tested; oversized datagram logging rate-limited (300-datagram test); HELLO advertises 4096x2160.
- build_ios.sh: IVs ios-lib archive is auto-discovered at <outdir>/../iv-ios; the link is checked with a throwaway -ENODEV P03 stub and that diagnostic binary is deleted. daemon/sdk_symbols.txt now lists every libSystem symbol the daemon + IV archive import, each checked against the SDKs usr/lib/libSystem.tbd. The only missing product symbol is P03s _n2vc_hw_open_dev.
- install.py: --force upgrades a file the receipt owns but whose content changed; a file with no receipt entry is still never replaced. stage.sh host-test covers refusal, --force, undo and undo --purge-vendor.

Still open (full list in dsh-state/workers/IP/STATUS.md): no phone run; P03 client/** absent (product link + client tool); client DMA PA source (proposed RWVC_DMA_INFO) is the first phone blocker; the HW timeout cannot interrupt a synchronous AP call (the AP IPI wait is bounded by the same value); fractional fps rounds to integer; reply drops on a full client queue are logged, client must drain.

R1 says vcodecd is R2s package; R2 has no directory yet. I asked hw-lead. Staying available for review findings.
